55: This case is comparable only etc. - [this passage serves as] the conclusion of the [Gemara's] reply [rejecting the possibility that the betrothal can spread to both halves]. This case is comparable only to that of an animal belonging to two partners, where there likewise is another mind that can prevent [the sanctification from spreading]. There, we did not say that the animal is fully sanctified by [the actions of] one of them.

It may not be sacrificed - since at the initiation of its sanctification it was not fit to be sacrificed, since only half of it was sanctified. It must be sold and another animal sacrificed using its value.
